visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a round face with two closed-eye arcs, a tear running down from the right eye and an open downturned mouth; reads as the crying face. The rejected drawing had an open head outline, blob eyes and a detached cheek mark. An r5 mouth failed the hole check; r6 passes.
omissions: The worried eyebrows are dropped (no room 8 above the eyes inside the rim); the tear is a short stroke hanging from the eye rather than a separate drop.
